assumptions.rationale: Educated assumption: Regular vetted presidential elections cannot renew or remove the supreme authority through genuinely competitive elections. Supreme leadership, not merely the subordinate presidency, is relevant to national leaders. This interprets implemented institutions, not an official questionnaire response; the exact normative preference is inferred.

Educated assumption: Ordinary adult suffrage is not education/intelligence-qualified, though candidate eligibility is restrictive. Exact current voter disqualification exceptions were not exhaustively retrieved; candidate vetting is not itself a voter test.

Educated assumption: Article 76 parliamentary investigation does not give independent opposition access to the protected supreme-leader institutions and state-linked foundations. Exclusion of genuine opposition and immunity from scrutiny outweigh the formal investigative provision. This interprets implemented institutions, not an official questionnaire response; the exact normative preference is inferred.

Educated assumption: Constitutional review exists, but the supreme leader appoints the judicial head and controls Guardian Council selection. These dependent institutions do not supply the independent constitutional check required by the statement. This interprets implemented institutions, not an official questionnaire response; the exact normative preference is inferred.

Educated assumption: Articles 59 and 110 make referendums dependent on parliamentary supermajority and leadership decree. This is not an implemented voter-controlled power to repeal a law; disagreement is qualified by the existence of binding institution-initiated referendums. This interprets implemented institutions, not an official questionnaire response; the exact normative preference is inferred.

Educated assumption: Article 110 places general policy and decisive appointments under supreme leadership. Subordinate executive and parliamentary work does not establish an independent veto over that paramount policy authority. The plural national leadership is assessed, without claiming the president alone decides everything. This interprets implemented institutions, not an official questionnaire response; the exact normative preference is inferred.
Educated assumption: Representative terms and political removal do not establish an individual voter recall vote. Moderate disagreement is likeliest; every council-level exception was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Supreme authority is insulated from effective voter sanction; vetted representatives and the formal Experts removal provision do not establish independent accountability in practice. Internal clerical selection and removal are not equivalent to accountable popular representation. This interprets implemented institutions, not an official questionnaire response; the exact normative preference is inferred.

Educated assumption: Security/interception authority makes serious-crime court-approved surveillance likely permissible. Judicial dependence is counterevidence to safeguards, not proof surveillance is prohibited; exact current warrant clauses were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Compulsory personal/moral and health regulation makes some self-protective mandates likely. Measures protecting others are narrower evidence; exact2026 primarily-self-benefit health powers were not exhaustively retrieved.

Educated assumption: Current digital surveillance and domestic network control make broad movement/data retention likely, qualified by constitutional privacy. No exact several-year suspicion-free retention period was verified, so agreement is moderate.
Educated assumption: National police traffic and intoxication enforcement suggest random driver checks. Exact suspicion-free testing statute and current implementation were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Security policing and preemptive detention suggest court-linked serious-risk movement restrictions are permissible. Abusive nonjudicial detention is not this precise court threshold; current procedure remains unverified.

Educated assumption: Current security operations and area enforcement make credible-threat suspicion-free searches likely. Exact individual-suspicion safeguards and authorization threshold were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Constitutional home/privacy safeguards coexist with documented arbitrary security searches and weak judicial protections. Mixed estimate distinguishes lawful prior authorization from current implementation; complete warrant exceptions were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Restrictive security administration makes routine civilian defence guns under violent-history checks alone unlikely. Exact current ordinary licensing categories were not traced; state armed institutions are not civilian licensing evidence.

Educated assumption: Documented arbitrary security detention and ineffective due process make broad prolonged executive detention likely, qualified by formal judicial institutions. Exact statutory indefinite terrorism power was not retrieved, so agreement is moderate rather than an invented unlimited clause.

Educated assumption: Iranian-Islamic state identity and restrictions on outside practices suggest national priority, qualified by recognized minority customs. No blanket migrant-conflict hierarchy was retrieved.

Educated assumption: Protected recognized minority personal/religious practices and refugee public services coexist with institutional exclusion. Mixed response reflects limited accommodation and unequal access, not universal migrant-practice funding.

Educated assumption: Common Persian/Islamic civic administration and controlled settlement suggest customs integration, qualified by tolerated Afghan and minority identities. Exact permanent-migrant cultural-conversion obligations were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Minority identities and long-standing refugee communities remain, while state identity and discrimination constrain recognition. Mixed estimate weighs preservation and assimilation pressure; no complete foreign-identity surrender rule was located.

Educated assumption: Article19 acknowledges ethnic equality and diverse languages, but Indigenous ceremonial acknowledgment is not equivalent to minority recognition. Mixed estimate weighs cultural inclusion against centralized official identity; exact Indigenous ceremonial duty was not found.

Educated assumption: Official Iranian-Islamic culture and faith institutions suggest predominant-tradition funding priority. Recognized minority institutions are counterevidence; actual current cultural allocation shares were not measured.

Educated assumption: Shared constitutional Islamic identity and state unity generally constrain distinct practices in conflict. Minority personal-law protections qualify disagreement; full cultural-conflict jurisprudence was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: National Islamic/Iranian official schedules predominate while recognized minority observances exist. Complete government scheduling accommodation was not audited, so agreement is moderate.

Educated assumption: Common public education and national administration favor wider participation rather than wholly separate migrant communities. Refugee restrictions and informal enclaves qualify this; complete integration programmes were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Persian document priority makes official migrant foreign-language signage unlikely as a general entitlement, qualified by regional-language and tourism usage. Exact signage rules were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Constitutional family education and national Islamic identity suggest shared-national emphasis, qualified by recognized minority family customs. Exact private family identity hierarchy was not documented.

Educated assumption: Islamic dress enforcement and recognized religious covering make continued legal religious full covering likely, qualified by security identification. The exact exception when all other full coverings are banned was not found.

Educated assumption: Common Persian/Islamic public institutions favor shared customs, qualified by recognized minority culture. Exact customs-versus-maintenance emphasis of migrant programmes remains unverified.

Educated assumption: Documented permit/status criteria and removal campaigns do not establish a strict annual permanent cap calculated from housing/workforce deficits. Moderate disagreement fits the literal numerical rule; all current cap regulations were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Documented dependent-family facilitation in investment/student routes makes family reunion for lawful settled migrants likely, qualified by exclusions and refugee/work restrictions. Iranian-citizen marriage differs from every permanent foreign resident; exact current general reunion rule remains unverified.

Educated assumption: Worker restrictions and temporary/document-specific admission suggest employer demand does not remove permanent limits. Long-residence and investment routes are counterevidence; exact labor-to-permanence rules were not fully traced.

Educated assumption: Current removal/reduced refugee access and service pressures suggest restriction despite potential labor benefit. Precise national housing-versus-growth rationale was not established, qualifying agreement.

Educated assumption: Family residence criteria are documented but a common annual permanent numerical cap was not verified. Moderate disagreement is likeliest; exact current quota accounting was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: National worker permit restrictions and narrowed work-without-family route mean a job offer alone generally does not authorize entry. Some employer/expert permits are counterevidence; complete current occupation permissions were not traced.

Educated assumption: Long-standing refugee protection and exceptions coexist with current deportation and difficult renewal access. Mixed estimate weighs real protection against restricted entry without inventing a cap-reached asylum guarantee.

Educated assumption: Long-standing Afghan/Iraqi hosting and Iranian family ties suggest cultural/regional proximity preference, qualified by restrictive return policy and other investor routes. Exact formal country-similarity ranking was not found.

Educated assumption: Some documented refugee health/education/social protection access indicates qualified noncitizen support, while current insurance/residence costs and work exclusions constrain it. School access alone is not all welfare/social housing; exact general benefit eligibility was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Selection and return policies emphasize status/security/economic criteria rather than increased numbers specifically for cultural difference. Diverse longstanding communities are counterevidence, not a current diversity-admission target.

Educated assumption: Regional armed networks and prior overseas operations suggest force can secure interests beyond response to an attack. Current2026 attacks on Iran are defensive-context counterevidence; exact full national force-use doctrine was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Actual current negotiations coexist with armed retaliation, threats and strategic coercion. Mixed estimate weighs both; wartime diplomacy does not establish universal diplomacy-first willingness to accept slower outcomes.

Educated assumption: Military prioritization and missile/security institutions show willingness to bear substantial costs, qualified by asymmetric deterrence rather than verified superiority over every opponent. Exact superiority-cost tradeoff remains inferred.

Educated assumption: Security doctrine and readiness make action against a strongly evidenced imminent attack likely. Actual retaliatory strikes are not proof of preemption rules; specific national threshold was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Prior regional force/proxy support is broader than direct attack-response alone, qualified by current defensive claims and actual attacks against Iran. Exact legal only-defensive constraint was not found.

Educated assumption: National male-service institution supports compulsory training, qualified by deferments/exemptions and current war disruption. Exact2026 duration and conscription changes were not fully retrieved.

Educated assumption: Continued sovereignty/security red lines despite actual talks suggest reluctance to make substantial weakening concessions. Diplomacy is counterevidence; offers are not concluded concessions and exact accepted tradeoffs remain unverified.

Educated assumption: AI/security development coexists with adopted AI human-oversight ethics. Mixed estimate distinguishes military targeting assistance from authority to select/attack without human approval; no specific current lethal-autonomy rule was found.

Educated assumption: Territorial defence and current survival war coexist with prior regional expeditionary/proxy operations. Mixed estimate distinguishes national priorities and overseas capacity; precise resource allocation was not measured.

Educated assumption: Prior regional overseas presence and continuing armed networks suggest sustained beyond-border capability, qualified by2026 degradation. Proxies differ from national troops; exact current prolonged expeditionary readiness was not verified.

Educated assumption: Diplomatic sovereignty claims coexist with forceful regional/territorial security conduct. Mixed estimate weighs restraint and coercion; no universal unresolved-dispute-versus-war rule was retrieved.

Educated assumption: Current military deterrent warnings and coercive security approach suggest threats can seek concessions, qualified by real negotiations. Exact international-dispute threat inventory was not exhaustively traced.

Educated assumption: Current armed resolve and resistance to weakening conditions suggest resolve can outweigh war-risk reduction. Actual peace diplomacy qualifies disagreement; exact hierarchy remains contextual inference.

Educated assumption: Security/intelligence institutions and expanded espionage framework suggest foreign military intelligence is accepted despite diplomatic risks. Criminalizing hostile espionage alone is not proof of own covert policy; exact operations remain unverified.

Educated assumption: Negotiation of security/nuclear terms coexists with strong defence red lines. Mixed estimate weighs reciprocal restraint against capability preservation; no achieved general military-reduction agreement was located.

Educated assumption: Sovereignty emphasis and resistance to external mandates make opposed international institutional commands unlikely to be accepted broadly. Accepted specific treaty obligations are counterevidence; precise current compulsory mechanisms were not fully inventoried.

Educated assumption: National constitutional/religious supremacy suggests domestic finality where international rulings conflict, qualified by accepted case-specific international litigation. Exact court-conflict doctrine was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Long-term regional/security/trade cooperation accepts some constraints while sovereign nonalignment remains constitutional. Specific binding collective-defence duties were not found, so agreement is moderate rather than assumed alliance subordination.

Educated assumption: Sovereign treaty choice and domestic ratification suggest no general external approval veto on withdrawal, subject to agreed notice/procedure. Every current treaty withdrawal clause was not traced.

Educated assumption: Accepted state dispute mechanisms coexist with rejection of broad external scrutiny of own officials. Mixed response distinguishes state litigation from universal official-crime jurisdiction; the complete current accepted-court inventory was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Constitutional environmental duty and international biosafety cooperation coexist with sovereign control. Independent international environmental decision power is unlikely; exact delegated cross-border authority was not found.

Educated assumption: Constitutional nonalignment and sovereign regional participation make compulsory uniform foreign-policy bloc positions unlikely. SCO/BRICS cooperation differs from joining a political federation; precise obligations remain qualified.

Educated assumption: External human-rights findings and national resistance do not provide a recognized general international power to require domestic legal change. Treaties/reporting commitments are counterevidence; exact binding adjudicatory channels were not fully retrieved.

Educated assumption: Regional trade/cooperation and UN participation pool some effort/funding, qualified by national control. Exact current independently delegated pooled decisions were not exhaustively traced.

Educated assumption: National sovereignty and selective regional alignments suggest reluctance to enforce collective rules when neutrality benefits immediate interests. Specific cooperative treaty enforcement is counterevidence; exact hypothetical tradeoff remains inferred.

Educated assumption: Private small and commercial businesses plausibly predominate by firm count despite strategic state and quasi-state output dominance. Moderate private ownership is the likeliest answer to most businesses, not an output-weighted ownership question. Exact current ownership census was not retrieved and nominal private regime-linked control qualifies the choice.

Educated assumption: Documented state-linked favoritism and retention of strategic enterprises make a general comparable-provider preference for independent private ownership unlikely. Formal privatization and private rights qualify disagreement; no comprehensive current comparable-cost ownership directive was retrieved.

Educated assumption: State commercial holdings and public/cooperative constitutional sectors suggest public establishment beyond natural monopolies, qualified by privatization and private enterprise. Exact current competitive-enterprise creation inventory was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Article44 rail public ownership and actual state transport control support public passenger infrastructure. Private service participation is counterevidence; precise current track-title inventory was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Contracting and private clinics coexist with direct public provision and political access distortions. Mixed response addresses comparable lower-cost provision separately; no universal current contracting presumption was found.

Educated assumption: Public housing schemes and private household/property ownership coexist. Mixed response distinguishes loans/subsidized ownership from public rental title; substantial national rental share was not measured.

Educated assumption: Security-linked/state strategic control makes relying only on regulation of private security-critical enterprises unlikely. Private contractors exist; exact current industry-specific title and adequacy rules were not fully retrieved.

Educated assumption: Private/state-linked contractors coexist with municipal/public providers. Mixed response addresses routine waste services independently from strategic holdings; exact current provider ownership/preferences were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Retained strategic energy/security ownership and state-linked consolidation favor holding assets despite sale revenue, qualified by formal privatization. Exact current revenue-for-control tradeoffs were not documented.

Educated assumption: Repeated state backing and state-linked transfers suggest sale to independent private owners is not an automatic response to losses. Privatization exists; exact loss-triggered divestment rules were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Domestic protective tariffs persist alongside actual regional concessions. Exact2026 all-product tariff schedule was not retrieved; older average rates are not presented as current.

Educated assumption: Protected strategic production and opaque import administration reject removal of most barriers, qualified by EAEU liberalization. Exact current share of barriers removed was not quantified.

Educated assumption: State/state-linked procurement preference and domestic self-reliance suggest local suppliers favored, qualified by foreign infrastructure/technology sourcing. Exact permitted higher-price preference was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Import/currency administration constrains buying solely on best foreign terms. External sanctions are separate counterfactual restrictions, not all voluntary Iranian policy; exact current origin/permit rules were not fully traced.

Educated assumption: Essential food/industrial self-reliance and protected sectors suggest preserving domestic capacity through import controls. Specific cheaper-import tradeoffs were not comprehensively documented.

Educated assumption: Actual regional reciprocal concessions and protection suggest little general unilateral liberalization regardless of partners. Autonomous reforms may occur; complete2026 unilateral tariff inventory was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Domestic industrial protection and strategic production support suggest infant-industry restrictions can be accepted, qualified by consumer costs and treaty exceptions. Exact temporary import measures/duration were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Constitutional foreign-concession restrictions and controlled foreign investment prevent wholly identical establishment terms, qualified by licensed investment facilitation. Exact current sector exceptions were not fully checked.

Educated assumption: Domestic agriculture/self-sufficiency protection suggests crop import restraint, qualified by actual necessary food imports. Exact current crop-specific bans/quotas were not exhaustively retrieved.
Educated assumption: Protected strategic production and domestic tariff mechanisms make adjustment without protection unlikely as a general rule. Regional competitive exposure qualifies disagreement.

Educated assumption: Coercive trade posture coexists with negotiated regional concessions and constraints on sanction-targeted exports. Mixed estimate avoids treating foreign sanctions as actual Iranian import-tariff retaliation; no comprehensive current retaliatory schedule was found.

Educated assumption: Ordinary tax systems coexist with differentiated border/sector levies and preferences. Mixed response distinguishes tariffs from product taxes; complete current equal domestic/imported excise treatment was not verified.

Educated assumption: Domestic protection tools coexist with dependence on regional partners’ goods. Mixed estimate weighs protective capacity and negotiated exceptions; actual current large-foreign-subsidy restrictions were not located.

Educated assumption: Constitutional foreign-concession restrictions and strategic state ownership suggest limiting foreign control, qualified by licensed investment. Exact current screening thresholds and additional-investment tradeoff remain unverified.

Educated assumption: Current cross-border internet controls and domestic digital infrastructure restrict foreign online access, qualified by partially restored services. Content/security regulation differs from trade restrictions; exact digital-trade exemption inventory was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Ordinary private choices coexist with strategic state direction, politically controlled entry and national planning. Mixed estimate addresses actual split scope; complete2026 autonomy of private production was not measured.

Educated assumption: National planning and state strategic production control suggest compulsory targets in important sectors, qualified by private commerce. Exact2026 legally enforced output schedules were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Markets set many ordinary prices while essential prices and exchange rates are administered. Mixed response reflects real distinct sectors; exact proportion of prices under each regime was not measured.

Educated assumption: Private demand-based operation coexists with substantial politically/state-directed entry, exit and production. Mixed answer weighs both; no universal privately demand-driven closure rule was established.

Educated assumption: Strong licensing and strategic entry barriers make unrestricted industry entry unlikely, qualified by private business rights. A license is not necessarily proof-of-need; exact current economic-need tests were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: State banking and politically directed credit favor national priorities, qualified by commercial/private lending. Exact2026 binding industry lending directives were not fully retrieved.

Educated assumption: Currency controls, multiple rates and foreign-exchange administration constrain free outward movement. Sanctions are separate external barriers; exact current approval exceptions were not fully audited.

Educated assumption: National monetary control and restricted payment/foreign exchange make general private-currency competition unlikely. Exact2026 crypto-versus-legal-tender rules were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: National LaborCode wage-floor machinery makes an enforced minimum more likely than exclusively private bargaining. Exact wartime2026 amounts/exemptions were not independently verified.

Educated assumption: National minimums/public schedules and restricted labor institutions coexist with private above-floor negotiations. Mixed estimate concerns wages generally, not assuming every wage equals the minimum; exact coverage was not measured.

Educated assumption: Documented weak central-bank independence and government monetary interference support development-directed policy, qualified by stabilization duties. Exact current legally binding rate/lending commands were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Private rental/property markets coexist with housing intervention and control. Mixed response weighs both; precise2026 rent ceilings and coverage were not independently retrieved.

Educated assumption: Ordinary strategic planning and public distribution/price management go beyond emergencies, qualified by private decentralized trade. No claim every firm’s output is nationally scheduled is made; exact2026 coordination coverage remains unverified.

Educated assumption: Income-based cash and progressive taxes coexist with inadequate coverage, exemptions and inflation erosion. Mixed estimate reflects redistribution with limited actual equalization, not equating public ownership or services with cash.

Educated assumption: Income-based cash and constitutional poverty/social-security commitments accept some redistributive taxation, qualified by preferential exemptions and fiscal constraints. Inequality-alone rationale was not explicitly retrieved.

Educated assumption: Universal constitutional social-security aspirations and targeted transfers coexist with fiscal strain and limited delivered adequacy. Mixed estimate weighs strengthening aims and actual constraints; a current higher-tax stronger minimum was not verified.

Educated assumption: Targeted modest cash and strained contributory protection suggest basic safety rather than substantial living-standard equalization. Broad transfers and wage replacement are counterevidence; current distribution effects remain unmeasured.

Educated assumption: Graduated ordinary income taxation suggests larger tax shares at higher earnings, qualified by privileged exemptions and evasion. Exact enacted1405earnings thresholds/rates were not retrieved, so historical tax tables are not asserted current.

Educated assumption: Exemptions and tax concessions coexist with income-targeted support and graduated taxation. Mixed estimate reflects competing mechanisms, without claiming a universal preference for wider income gaps.

Educated assumption: Inheritance taxation exists in the direct-tax framework and general revenue supports transfers. Specific large-estate progression/earmarking for low-income support was not verified, so agreement is moderate contextual inference.

Educated assumption: Unemployment lawArticle7has contributory duration limits, qualified by pensions/disability and continuing household cash. Exact current amended duration schedule was not fully retrieved after ILO PDF failure; no fabricated2026month count is claimed.

Educated assumption: Inheritance/property/asset levies coexist with privileged exempt wealth and no verified broad net-wealth transfer levy. Mixed estimate distinguishes specific asset taxes from general accumulated-wealth taxation; complete1405changes were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Modest benefits and fiscal strain suggest restrained funding burden, qualified by continuing transfers and inflation-driven need. Exact modesty-to-lower-tax justification remains inferred.

Educated assumption: Inflation erosion, pension arrears and coverage gaps make guaranteed ordinary social participation unlikely. Some covered wage/pension benefits are counterevidence; complete2026adequacy was not measured.

Educated assumption: Continuing cash/poverty institutions suggest cuts are not an overriding priority, qualified by exemptions and fiscal austerity. Current tax-cut-versus-cash budget totals were not verified.

Educated assumption: Targeted household cash and unemployment-law low-wage top-up can supplement earnings. Exact current national coverage and amended top-up rules were not retrieved; food coupons are not freely disposable cash.

Educated assumption: Graduated earnings rates make equal marginal taxation across income ranks unlikely. Exact current1405schedule was not retrieved, qualifying disagreement rather than inventing annual numbers.

Educated assumption: Constitutional public/state land and confiscation rules do not establish a current compensated redistribution of large private estates. Moderate disagreement is likeliest; every land-transfer programme was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Historical broad cash recipients and contributory benefits extend beyond basic-needs destitution, though recent high-income removal/tightening narrows access. Exact2026cash eligibility changes were not independently verified; coupon exclusions are not cash exclusions.

Educated assumption: Faith-oriented constitutional education and state Islamic cultural institutions make purely nonpersuasive comparative teaching unlikely. Recognized minorities have own religious education; exact current curriculum/opt-outs were not fully retrieved.

Educated assumption: Official Islamic education and propagation support cultivated recognized faith, qualified by minority religious schooling. Exact school-specific requirements were not fully audited.

Educated assumption: Constitutional religious oaths and official state faith observance suggest organized worship at some ceremonies, qualified by ordinary secular administration. Oaths are not themselves every worship service; full current ceremony practice was not audited.

Educated assumption: Official Islam and state religious symbolism suggest endorsed symbols in some government buildings, qualified by ordinary civil functions. The complete current display inventory was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Official Islamic festival recognition supports retained religious holidays, with Iranian cultural holidays also observed. Exact2026holiday decree was not retrieved, so agreement is moderate.

Educated assumption: Constitutional clerical qualifications for selected state positions are not automatic government seats solely from holding an outside religious office. Selection by Experts and appointment of qualified jurists support moderate agreement with rejecting automatic seats; the full inventory of office-linked representation exceptions was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: TaxAct139specifically exempts shrines, mosques, religious endowments and propagation income beyond ordinary charitable work. Exact current1405limits/amendments were not fully retrieved, so moderate agreement relies on actual legislative framework with dated consolidation limits.

Educated assumption: Constitutional Islamic family/moral continuity and actual controls resist broad custom revision, qualified by limited reform and individual resistance. Citizen support for change is not treated as implemented national policy.

Educated assumption: Official moral/religious criteria and family sanctity favor established norms, qualified by modern education and selected legal adaptation. Exact traditional-versus-new-value hierarchy across every custom remains inferred.

Educated assumption: Marriage/religious family framework privileges recognized traditional households, qualified by aid to vulnerable families and children. Exact national equal social-recognition measures were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Constitutional motherhood/family roles and gender-linked restrictions encourage distinct roles, qualified by women’s education/work. No claim every woman must follow one occupation is made; precise current role guidance remains inferred.

Educated assumption: Article10family sanctity and national marriage promotion favor two-parent married households, qualified by social protection outside them. Exact preference in current benefits/social recognition remains contextual inference.

Educated assumption: Restrictive reproductive institutions and Islamic family priorities make general early-choice acceptance unlikely, qualified by lawful exceptional medical access. Exact abortion authorization amendments and citizen attitudes were not fully retrieved.

Educated assumption: Family religious upbringing coexists with centrally prescribed state Islamic curriculum. Mixed estimate weighs aligned tradition and limited parental override; exact final school opt-out authority was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Traditional sex/family terminology coexists with some legally recognized gender-transition practice. Mixed estimate distinguishes approved transition from universal nonbinary/self-identification language reform; complete2026terminology rules were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Constitutional Islamic moral education and religious propagation prioritize established norms, qualified by learning innovation. Exact established-versus-new custom priorities remain contextual inference.

Educated assumption: Gender role restrictions and discrimination weaken equal institutional role acceptance, qualified by women’s education/work and selected transition recognition. Precise current acceptance across every role was not measured.

Educated assumption: Retained religious family/moral institutions favor controlled gradual change, qualified by rapid technological and political/security measures. Exact response to popular demand for faster social reform remains inferred.

Educated assumption: Faith-oriented moral education and repression of same-sex relations make compulsory inclusive orientation/identity teaching unlikely. Exact2026national curriculum content/opt-outs were not fully retrieved.

Educated assumption: Constitutional religious and Iranian heritage transmission favors ancestral continuity, qualified by modern development. Exact preservation when practical purpose disappears was not explicitly documented.

Educated assumption: Adopted AI development and scientific promotion favor benefits-led deployment, qualified by ethics/risk safeguards. Targets are not delivered all-technology rollout; exact blanket permission under uncertain long-term risk was not found.

Educated assumption: Industry/digital innovation goals and biotechnology authorization allow development beyond permanent small trials, qualified by sandboxes and risk assessment. No uniform all-technology trial-only rule was retrieved.

Educated assumption: Actual development/energy priorities and environmental deterioration suggest substantial projects can outweigh habitat protection. Constitutional environment duty is counterevidence; exact current irreversible-loss approval decisions were not audited.

Educated assumption: Medical/biosafety authorization and health safeguards suggest caution before widespread novel treatment. Exact long-term evidence thresholds across technologies were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: AI document expressly supports productivity, vocational reskilling and retraining current workers while preserving human strengths. Moderate agreement fits adoption through disruption, but precise willingness to replace many jobs and actual broad delivery are unverified.

Educated assumption: Development/resource priorities and documented habitat/water pressure suggest undisturbed habitat does not always prevail, qualified by Article50environmental protection. Complete2026project priorities were not measured.

Educated assumption: Health/biosafety and religious food standards suggest caution about premature cultivated-meat replacement. GMO regulation is not a cultivated-meat ban; exact current national authorization was not found.

Educated assumption: Medical risk and AI human-effects research safeguards make healthy brain enhancement limited research likely. No specific current invasive enhancement law was retrieved, so agreement is qualified inference.

Educated assumption: Technology/reconstruction and energy priorities coexist with subsidy-law efficiency/conservation measures and environmental duties. Mixed estimate reflects both, not verified priority for unproven climate technology over consumption reductions.

Educated assumption: Constitutional environmental protection/risk assessment coexist with actual rapid development and environmental failures. Mixed response weighs both; no automatic delay for every poorly understood project was found.

Educated assumption: Health/biosafety controls make basic-safety-only healthy-person implants unlikely. Scientific advancement does not establish invasive enhancement permission; exact authorization remains unverified.

Educated assumption: AI document supports oversight, limited regulatory sandboxes and health applications, suggesting supervised reliable medical AI. Exact patient-group reliability threshold was not found, so agreement is moderate.

Educated assumption: Religious/medical risk framework makes embryo enhancement trials unlikely, qualified by accepted biotechnology research. Embryo/stem-cell disease research is not healthy-ability germline enhancement; specific current rules were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Actual biosafety framework requires environmental risk documentation and separate release authority. Long-term ecosystem evidence requirement is likely, qualified by lawful authorized GMimports; exact length and cultivation threshold were not verified.

Educated assumption: National construction/housing/transport priorities suggest expansion can outweigh undeveloped-land preservation, qualified by Article50and local rights. Complete current land-choice inventory was not audited.

Educated assumption: Biosafety risk assessment and AI human-oversight/ethics support caution for irreversible harm, qualified by ambitious development. Exact uniform strong-evidence threshold across technologies was not located.

Educated assumption: National legal hierarchy and constrained councils suggest national final authority over competence disputes, qualified by constitutional councils and legal review. Exact current dispute procedure was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: National administrative/legal primacy allows displacement of obstructive local policy, qualified by constitutional council protections. Exact programme-only override mechanism was not fully retrieved.

Educated assumption: National security/police hierarchy suggests central police direction rather than autonomous regional command, qualified by local deployment. Exact current command statute was not separately retrieved.

Educated assumption: National revenue allocation and centralized resources make keeping most locally raised tax unlikely. Local income and transfers are counterevidence; exact2026retained aggregate share was not measured.

Educated assumption: Municipal revenue/levy authority coexists with nationally defined fiscal rules. Mixed estimate distinguishes local service charges from independent regional tax-rate authority; exact current tax powers were not fully retrieved.

Educated assumption: National laws define councils and provincial administration, making unilateral local-voter boundary/power changes unlikely. Exact current boundary approval procedures were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: National insurance/health institutions set coverage while local facilities deliver it. Exact current region-specific optional treatments and benefit schedule were not fully retrieved, qualifying national preference.

Educated assumption: Centralized Islamic governance and limited minority institutions make independent Indigenous territorial self-rule unlikely. Recognized local/customary identities are counterevidence but not automatically Indigenous sovereignty; precise current category institutions were not found.
Educated assumption: National fiscal hierarchy suggests limits on regional low-tax competition, qualified by municipal revenues. Exact current allowable rate competition was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Local councils supervise local affairs while national public-resource/environment institutions govern land and wildlife. Mixed response reflects divided administration, not unverified full regional authority where effects remain local.

Educated assumption: National security/disaster institutions and constitutional emergency coordination suggest central direction across regions, qualified by local implementation. Exact override when local plans conflict was not fully traced.

Educated assumption: Actual parenting counselor training treats family support/social learning as behavior-shaping causes. Moderate environmental predominance is likeliest, qualified by individual development; the local training does not quantify all inherited influences.

Educated assumption: Education/scientific-learning institutions favor opportunity effects over inherited national IQ hierarchy. No adopted country-IQ genetic decomposition was found; national scientific aspiration is not an IQ causation finding.

Educated assumption: Learned religious/social roles coexist with sex-linked legal institutions and developmental individuality. Mixed interaction is likeliest, without equating legal roles with measured biological behavioral predominance.

Educated assumption: Family relationship/mental-health support addresses stress through experience while recognizing individual development. Interaction is likeliest; no biological-versus-experiential predominance measure was retrieved.
Educated assumption: Training and educational opportunities suggest experiences shape interests. Exact comparative inherited contribution was not quantified, so agreement is moderate.
Educated assumption: Guided adolescent skills and social learning make inherited risk predominance unlikely, qualified by personal variation. No trait-specific genetic ranking was retrieved.

Educated assumption: Strengthened family relationships and community guidance cultivate cooperation through surroundings. Moderate experiential predominance is likeliest; national hereditary contribution was not quantified.
Educated assumption: Responsive parenting/social support suggests empathy is substantially learned. No official empathy-specific inherited predominance theory was found, qualifying disagreement.

Educated assumption: Educational/mental-health interventions affect attention while developmental differences remain recognized. Mixed interaction is likeliest; no exact predominant attention cause was measured.

Educated assumption: Islamic moral transmission and parenting socialization give learned norms causal weight. Immediate intuitive reaction differs from instructed morality, so biological predominance is only moderately rejected.

Educated assumption: Family/mental-health experience interventions suggest learned threat responses. Actual security threat rhetoric is not genetic causal evidence; precise predominant cause remains unquantified.

Educated assumption: Individual developmental variation and responsive family support coexist. Temperament is likeliest interactive, rather than automatic biology or upbringing predominance; no quantified adopted causal decomposition was retrieved.

Educated assumption: Strong learned modesty/cultural expectations suggest attractiveness conventions have substantial cultural causation. They are not an attractiveness-genetics study, so predominance remains moderate contextual inference.

Educated assumption: Constitutional ethnic equality and contextual parenting/education do not establish a racial-biological violence hierarchy. Actual ethnic discrimination is counterevidence to equal treatment, not proof of an adopted genetic violence theory; exact causation remains unverified.

Educated assumption: Moral education and adolescent parenting teach disciplined habits through practice. Moderate learning predominance is likeliest over inherited racial tendencies; no race-genetic comparison was measured.

Educated assumption: Documented social/legal workforce barriers and educational attainment favor social expectations over lower inherent female economic value. Traditional role institutions are counterevidence, not a measured pay-gap decomposition.
